HireIQ Recruitment

Candidate Notification System

Dear {{candidate_name}},

Thank you for applying for the position of {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}.

We have successfully received your application (Application ID: {{application_id}}). Our recruitment team is currently reviewing your profile and credentials.

What happens next?
Our hiring team and automated matching engine will evaluate your qualifications against the role requirements. If your profile matches, we will reach out regarding the next steps in our hiring process.

You can track the live status of your application anytime by visiting your candidate portal:

View Application Status

Best regards,
Talent Acquisition Team

name: Candidate Rejection Notice
subject: Application Update: {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
body_html:
Dear {{candidate_name}},

Thank you very much for taking the time to apply and interview for the {{job_title}} role at {{company_name}}.

After careful deliberation, we have decided to move forward with another applicant whose specific experience aligns more closely with our immediate requirements.

{{feedback_notes}}

With your permission, we would love to keep your profile in our Talent Pool for consideration when matching opportunities open in the future.

We wish you the very best in your professional journey.

Sincerely,
Talent Acquisition Team
{{company_name}}
